qa: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] If it's your turn, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 4 Digimon card with the [Insectoid] or [Free] trait in your trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
